about_the_game:
17-year-old Hope Song returns home from school to find her parents missing. Unable to find answers for their strange disappearance, she digs into their case herself. Using her observant eye as an artist to piece together clues, Hope uncovers a dark world that lies beneath the surface of her peaceful urban life.

Hope in the City is a non-linear narrative mystery game from the team behind the 2023 GDC Pitch Winner Sky of Tides and the Annie Award-nominated Eternal Spring, Canada’s first animated feature chosen as the Best International Feature Film entry at the Academy Awards®.

Solve the Mystery Through Artful Investigation

Gather clues, record observations, and piece together the truth using Hope’s sketchbook. Dive deep into the investigation to uncover what lies beneath the city’s calm facade.

A Unique Gameplay Mechanic, Based on Thoughts

Progress as you build your observations into theories and make breakthroughs that will get you closer to solving the mysterious disappearance of your parents.

Creative and Unique Triangulated Art Style

Experience a bold triangulated art style that blends story and visuals, creating a unique world that invites closer exploration.
